price_level_has_earlier_orders.meaning: a price level already exists containing earlier orders when a new limit order is appended
price_level_has_earlier_orders.checkpoint: before appending the new limit order

earlier_orders_reachable_after_removal.meaning: earlier orders at the same price level remain reachable by matching, amending, or cancelling logic after the appended order is removed
earlier_orders_reachable_after_removal.checkpoint: after removal of the appended order

claims.scope: limit order append to existing price level, then cancellation/full fill/expiry removal

preconditions.text: A price level already exists with earlier orders when a new limit order is appended to it.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Removing an appended order should preserve the linked-list links to earlier orders at the same price level so they remain reachable and their collateral releasable.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Earlier orders at that price become unreachable by matching, amending, or cancelling logic.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Removal of the appended order is triggered by cancellation, full fill, or expiry.
The linked list is a doubly-linked per-price-level order list within the order book contract.

limitations: Deferred impact collateral_locked (makers cannot withdraw or reuse tokens committed to ghost orders) to a future claim.
Reachability is a qualitative Boolean; concrete list-pointer binding is deferred to code-level analysis.
Report does not establish who triggers removal or whether it is permissionless.
